assumptions: 'wait for the root problem resolution' is the policy 9 enumeration value 'Awaiting Problem' (Awaiting Change / Awaiting Caller / Awaiting Problem)
INC_057 is status new on the seed; new -> on_hold is a valid policy 3.3 transition
carries jointly the composite check combined_all_operations_validation (its INC_057 part)

requirements.text: put that HR DB ticket on hold while we wait for the root problem resolution
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident_sla WHERE incident_sla_id = 'TSLA_022' AND stage = 'paused'
assumptions: policy 6: the SLA timer must be paused (stage = paused) when an incident is on_hold with on_hold_reason Awaiting Problem, which the INC_057 hold sets
TSLA_022 (SLA_001) is INC_057's only SLA row, stage in_progress on the seed; every on-hold incident on the seed that has an SLA row has it paused (TSLA_007, TSLA_014, TSLA_024)
no tool writes this table; the server may pause it on update_incident, or it may stay unmet

requirements.text: he needs a Post-Outage Compliance Audit logged. Assign it to the same manager who's already handling the main database outage
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM incident WHERE incident_id = 'INC_101' AND caller_id = 'USER_059' AND assigned_to = 'USER_059' AND short_description = 'Post-Outage Compliance Audit' AND category = 'database' AND status = 'new' AND impact = 'low' AND urgency = 'low' AND priority = 'planning'
assumptions: id assumed next in sequence (INC_101 after INC_100); the only incident the task creates
the manager handling the main database outage is INC_001.assigned_to = USER_059 (Gregory Richards, role manager, active), which satisfies policy 3.2's role and activity rules
caller_id USER_059 kept from the benchmark check; 'he needs ... logged' makes Gregory Richards the user affected, which agrees
short_description taken verbatim from the request's 'Post-Outage Compliance Audit'
category database, impact low, urgency low and priority planning kept from the benchmark check; not fixed by request or policy (priority planning follows low/low in the policy 3.1 matrix)
status new is the policy 3.1 default
number = 'INC-000101' in the benchmark check is a server-kept column and is not a cell
assignment_group not tested: the request names none, the check tests none, and USER_059 is in no group on the seed while already holding INC_001
carries jointly the composite check combined_all_operations_validation (its INC_101 part)

child_incident_mappings_creation.evidence: carried by the three link requirements, one per (parent, child) pair; its mapping-id list CINC_007-009 is not carried, since three rows are created in no fixed order and each is selected by its natural key

incident_inc_101_creation.evidence: every predicate is carried by the audit-incident requirement except number = 'INC-000101', a server-kept column that is never a cell

combined_all_operations_validation.evidence: a UNION ALL (expected 5 = 3 + 1 + 1) over the three links, the INC_057 hold and the INC_101 create, cells the other carried checks test; carried jointly by the five requirements that carry its parts, without its mapping ids (several rows created in no fixed order) and number (server-kept). disagreement: disposition: A kept it without naming it in any source, B excluded it as a duplicate; chose kept because a composite over carried cells is carried jointly

notes:
disagreement: disposition: combined_all_operations_validation: A kept it without naming it in any source, B excluded it as a duplicate of the first three checks; chose kept, carried jointly, because it is a UNION ALL over cells other carried checks test (the three links, the INC_057 hold, the INC_101 create), so each requirement that carries one of its parts names it; its mapping ids CINC_007-009 and number INC-000101 are not carried, as the three links are created in no fixed order and number is server-kept.
disagreement: missing requirement: the pause of INC_057's SLA row TSLA_022 (stage = paused); A has it, B does not; kept because policy 6 requires the SLA timer to be paused when an incident is on_hold with reason Awaiting Problem, which the requested hold sets, and every on-hold incident on the seed with an SLA row has it paused; no tool writes this table.
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that INC_053 'Disk Space' is not linked to INC_001 (expected 0); B has it, A does not, relying on the parent count of 6; kept because INC_053 is the near match of 'Disk Full' on the seed (same caller, assignee and group as INC_030), so it is the boundary of that selector, and the stay names the row a count alone cannot.
disagreement: value: the INC_030 stay: A tests status = in_progress and on_hold_reason IS NULL, B status = in_progress only; chose A's tighter predicate because a hold sets the reason as well as the status; both hold on the seed.
disagreement: value: the HR DB and Disk Full links: A writes one set requirement (child_incident IN ('INC_057', 'INC_030'), expected 2), B one requirement per (parent, child) pair; chose one per pair, which selects each created row by its own natural key, is as strict under the UNIQUE (parent_incident, child_incident) constraint, and reports each link on its own.
disagreement: value: the form of audit_trail_consistency: A carries it as org_id = 'ORG_001' on the created INC_101, B as the check's three-way join counting 3 with a cell keyed by a table alias; chose the flat org_id cell because INC_001, INC_057 and INC_030 are ORG_001 on the seed, so the audit's org is the join's only open cell, and a cell keyed by column fits the audit; the join's link part is carried by the three link requirements, which name the check in their source.
parent_child_relationship_integrity's description says 'exactly three' children, but the seed already has three (INC_044, INC_069, INC_082) and its expected value 6 is right.
Policy 3.2 wants assigned_to to be a member of the assignment_group, but USER_059 is in no group on the seed while already holding INC_001, so no group cell is written for the audit incident.
incident.parent_incident on the three children is not tested: the seed's existing children of INC_001 carry it, but the request names the link and the benchmark measures it in child_incident.
